# Copilot instructions for Infinite

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It is the authoritative instruction file for every AI agent and assistant in this repository.

The rule that matters most: never write private, personal, or machine-specific information into code, tests, fixtures, docs, comments, or commit messages. That covers local filesystem paths such as home-directory paths, real names, usernames, handles and emails, real IP addresses, hostnames and fingerprints, and any secret or credential. Use repository-relative paths and neutral placeholders. `AGENTS.md` lists the full set and the scan to run before committing.
